notes.title: patch notes 19.12
notes.content:
- performance improvements (also added key command "alt" + "8" (numpad) to kill all animals on map for better performance. The animal spawn procedure will start like a new game again)
- increased the stunning time of the animals from 10 minutes to 30 minutes
- Wildlife breeding system balanced
- Fixed a bug where furniture could not be placed on plank floors and ceilings
- added more usable weapons to hunting hut
- Names of collectibles are displayed in the HUD
- minor HUD improvements
- Foundations can now be placed under buildings to close holes and smooth them out (mainly aftermath buildings)
- Mine animations when starting/stopping production
- all fuel types can now be used in ovens
- prefecture collision bug fixed
- quarries now need fuel 
- Optimization of animal breeding
- some texture bugs fixed
- aftermath map bug fixed
- Furniture can now also be placed on the landscape
- minor bug fixes

notes.title: patch notes 23.11
notes.content:
building foundations added ( aftermath)
crafting system balancing
Stairs added for both directions
